title: test-ordinal-ratchet: detecting shadowed and ordinal-colliding test names in Python
description: Zero-dependency AST detector for Python test suites that separates three distinct collision classes: shadow (same scope, same name -- the later definition silently overwrites the earlier one and CI stays green), ordinal (same scope, same numeric stem -- ratcheted one way), and shared (same number, different class -- legal, reported, charged only under --strict). Measured over 7,782 test files in 23 public repositories; it found two tests in Textualize/rich that no longer run.
